stem: A series LCR circuit has resistance $6\ \Omega$, inductive reactance $10\ \Omega$ and capacitive reactance $2\ \Omega$. Its impedance is

Independent check: For a series LCR circuit, |Z| = √[R² + (X_L − X_C)²] = √[6² + (10 − 2)²] = 10 Ω.
solution:
For a series LCR circuit, $Z=\sqrt{R^2+(X_L-X_C)^2}$. Substituting the given values,
$$Z=\sqrt{6^2+(10-2)^2}=10\ \Omega.$$
